messages:
Riley (Support): Escalating to CS — customer 'HelixRx' onboarding blocked; embed ingestion returning 429s during first data load. Marking P0 and handing off.
Riley (Support): Ticket: https://redwood.zendesk.com/tickets/8899001 org=helixrx-prod. Log: ```2026-03-25T09:12:01Z ERROR rate_limit exceeded org=helixrx-prod route=/v1/embeds token_batch=0a3f```
Priya (CS): Ack. Sam — renewal touchpoint in ~10 days for this pilot, right?
Sam (CSM): Correct. Pilot conversion highly likely but sensitive to onboarding speed. If activation fails we'll need an executive check-in.
Eve (Solutions): If you can share the sample payload I can try to reproduce. Short-term idea: temporary quota bump + route to low-latency pool for their org. Need infra sign-off.
Riley (Support): Payload attached in ticket (sample_load.json). Customer message: "We're blocked — can you escalate?"
Infra Bot: Incident created INC-2026-0361 severity=P0 assigned=eng-runtime.
Priya (CS): Plan: 1) Ill send a brief customer comms within 30m to acknowledge and set expectations, 2) request temporary routing/quota via eng-runtime, 3) schedule a troubleshooting + onboarding call tomorrow with their engineering lead, 4) mark renewal risk=elevated in account tracker.
Sam (CSM): Agree. Priya, include offer for a short remediation session and confirmation of ETA to finish activation. Ill prep an internal renewal-notify note for our AE.
Eve (Solutions): Ive asked eng-runtime in the channel for a temporary route and +20% quota until 2026-03-31. Change request: ROUTE-991 queued.
Infra Bot: eng-runtime acknowledged; change ROUTE-991 scheduled (temp route + quota bump).
Riley (Support): Relayed to customer. They replied: "Thanks, available for call tomorrow 11am PT."
Priya (CS): Meeting invite sent for 2026-03-26 11:00 PT. Draft post-call summary template: root cause, mitigation, customer actions, confidence to convert. Ill paste the final summary here after the session.
Sam (CSM): Marking renewal watch active and setting risk->high until activation confirmed.
Priya (CS): Final: CS owns customer comms and renewal follow-up; Support will continue to monitor ticket for regressions. Will update thread after call. :white_check_mark:
